_meta: Allowlist format: each entry must have 'issue_code' (FHIR issue code string) and 'url_substring' (substring matched against diagnostics or location). An issue is allowlisted when BOTH match. See mh_integration/hl7_validator.py _is_allowlisted() for resolution logic. Do not add entries without a corresponding decision-log entry in docs/decisions.md.

justification: decision B5 (docs/decisions.md 2026-04-19): synthetic specialty CodeSystem by design; no real RxNorm/SNOMED codes in this dataset
all fhir-rag.example/* URIs are intentional synthetic placeholders for this preprint's controlled dataset (decision B5)

Synthea-inherited LOINC display-name mismatches. The synthetic dataset uses Synthea's base records verbatim; Synthea's terminology displays sometimes lag the LOINC canonical strings. Allowlisted because the issue is in the upstream Synthea generator, not the specialty-regimen overlay this project introduces.
Synthea-inherited inconsistency in some Practitioner/Organization role codes. Out of scope for the overlay; the bundles are not modified post-Synthea.
Synthea ships its own custom extension URL for DALY metadata without a published StructureDefinition. Inherited at freeze time; not introduced by the overlay.
Synthea ships its own custom extension URL for QALY metadata without a published StructureDefinition. Inherited at freeze time; not introduced by the overlay.

Known overlay limitation: the specialty-regimen overlay appends entries to a Synthea-produced transaction Bundle without populating entry.request on those entries, so the FHIR R4B invariant bdl-3 ('entry.request mandatory for batch/transaction/history') fails on every bundle. dataset-freeze-v1 is frozen so this is documented as a known violation; a future overlay regeneration should add entry.request blocks (or switch Bundle.type to 'collection') on appended entries. See overlay/specialty_regimen_generator.py lines 318/330/347/377.

Overlay uses 'SC' as the v3-RouteOfAdministration code for subcutaneous; the validator's bundled v3-RouteOfAdministration package does not include this two-letter code. The HL7 v3 vocabulary historically accepts 'SC' but the validator package considers it unknown. Documented overlay-coding choice; for a future overlay regeneration consider switching to 'SUBCUTAN'.
Same situation as 'SC' above, for inhalation route. Future overlay should consider 'IPINHL' or 'INHL'.
